value.rationale: Characteristic models constitute the unique minimum family from which all Horn models can be reconstructed by intersections. The two natural local binary propagation geometries admit complete exact size-resolved canonical representations, with a provable new linear asymptotic factor in going from the chain to cyclic feedback. This is a concrete motivated tractability/compression boundary adjacent to recent general hardness and bounded-degree translation results, not a rebranding of known Perrin numbers or an arbitrary finite slice.
